subject: The follow-up that books consultations while you sleep
html:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most fitness studios lose 60–80% of their leads not because the offer is wrong — but because the follow-up happens too late, too infrequently, or not at all. A prospect fills out your form on a Tuesday night and hears back Thursday afternoon. By then, they've already booked somewhere else.

Here's what the studios gaining ground right now are doing differently: they've built an AI-powered follow-up sequence that triggers the moment a lead comes in — day or night. The first message goes out in under 60 seconds. Over the next 5 days, a series of short, personalized texts and emails keeps {{business_name}} top of mind — asking about their goals, handling objections, and linking directly to a booking page. No manual work. No leads falling through the cracks. One studio I spoke with last month went from booking 4–5 consultations a week to 14–17 using this exact setup, without changing anything else in their marketing.

The whole thing runs on tools that cost less than $150/month combined and takes about a day to set up once you know what you're building.

Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — https://link.digigrowthllc.com/widget/booking/tydZBa2ehjdSRZopOMrn

Talk soon,
